## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List the checks performed and their results.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] The diff has one clear purpose and contains no dataset or generated files.
- [ ] Paths and configuration are portable.
- [ ] Input assumptions and failure behavior are explicit.
- [ ] Numerical calculations, units, coordinate frames, and sign conventions were checked.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or skipped checks are explained above.
- [ ] At least one reviewer approved this change before merge.
